"""Reconstruct only saved joint-limit numerical roots; no body advancement.

Uses the already reviewed exact-rational enclosure of the two binary cubic
constructions. This diagnoses numerical event ordering, not continuum accuracy.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sys

HARNESS=Path('/tmp/a1-body-local-error-map-20260927.py')
HARNESS_SHA='5c7b6cb36a274569dfe88e534987fb235fad3661088f7b8f9bcf3429a942cca8'
b=HARNESS.read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!=HARNESS_SHA:raise RuntimeError('reviewed envelope differs')
exec(compile(b.decode().split("\nif __name__=='__main__':",1)[0],'<reviewed no-build envelope>','exec'),globals())
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve()
PARENTS={
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us.json':'d667ce5b7af1e6292ab59755e70dfe217f75c7015d7d7b7340ba48d052240b7f',
 'FB-01aj-independent-history-6us.json':'162ab535a8a6dd03739973a388756fc1db16f6f4a3afeb86f7f41b22a6107b60',
}
TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-20us-joint-event-roots.json'
SCHEMA_OUT='guala.functional-body.saved-joint-event-roots.v1'


def diagnostic():
    global CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS
    b=ACCEPTED.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==ACCEPTED_SHA,'observer changed')
    exec(compile(b.decode().split('\nresult=dict(schema=SCHEMA,completed=False',1)[0],
                 '<reviewed numerical-root observer>','exec'),globals())
    CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS=10.,3000
    result=dict(schema=SCHEMA_OUT,completed=False,failure=None,cases=[],histories=[],
        mounted=False,full_body_qualification=False,continuum_enclosure=False,
        physical_intervals_advanced=0,scope='saved20.063ms joint36/38 numerical-root order only')
    try:
        result['algebraic_controls']=validate_localizer()
        for name,sha in PARENTS.items():
            budget();b=Path('docs/evidence',name).read_bytes()
            require(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==sha,'parent changed')
            p=json.loads(b)
            require(p['measurement_recorded'] and p['health_error'] is None and
                    p['execution']['exit_code']==0 and not p['execution']['survivors'],'parent custody differs')
            q=p['raw_measurement'];b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(q['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
            require(len(b)==q['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==q['raw_sha256'],'parent payload differs')
            d=json.loads(b);lane=d['lane'];out=dict(parent=name,lane=lane['label'],roots=[])
            result['histories'].append(out)
            for ordinal in (36,38):
                candidates=[r for r in lane['events'] if .02006<r['start_s']<.02007
                    and r['before_domain'][0][ordinal] and not r['after_domain'][0][ordinal]]
                require(len(candidates)==1,'not one saved lower-limit release')
                r=candidates[0];ops=r['hinge_operands']['lower:'+str(ordinal)]
                root_bounds=hinge_time(ops,1,0,r['start_s'],r['end_s'],'lower')
                lo,hi=map(F,root_bounds)
                observed=[v for v in chronological_events(r)
                    if v['before_domain'][0][ordinal] and not v['after_domain'][0][ordinal]]
                require(len(observed)==1,'sampled release ambiguous')
                event=observed[0]
                require(max(lo,F(event['start_s']))<=min(hi,F(event['end_s'])),
                        'numerical root outside sampled event bracket')
                out['roots'].append(dict(ordinal=ordinal,operands=ops,time_exact=root_bounds,
                    time_s=[float(lo),float(hi)],width_s=float(hi-lo),
                    source_piece=[r['start_s'],r['end_s']],sampled_bracket=[event['start_s'],event['end_s']],
                    predecessor_sha256=hashlib.sha256(base64.b64decode(r['predecessor_base64'],validate=True)).hexdigest()))
            a,b=out['roots'];separation=F(b['time_exact'][0])-F(a['time_exact'][1])
            out.update(joint36_strictly_before_joint38=separation>0,minimum_separation_s=float(separation))
        result['both_histories_joint36_strictly_before_joint38']=all(h['joint36_strictly_before_joint38'] for h in result['histories'])
        budget();result['completed']=True
    except Exception as error:
        result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=8))
    result.update(attempts=attempts,calls=probe.calls,call_accounting=audit,
        cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started_wall)
    print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1:]==['--child']:diagnostic()
    else:run()
